verdict.rationale: Bento is an agent-observability SaaS with a CLI and an ingestion API, so issuing scoped credentials for an agent is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence only shows browser-based CLI login that saves tokens to the keychain and a single auth header for OTel trace export. Nothing documents creating per-agent, scoped, or least-privilege API keys.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
